concept: Lambda: event-driven S3 event processing that scales to zero
tests: Choosing the cheapest, lowest-maintenance compute for an unpredictable event-driven load with short tasks.
expected: Lambda triggered by an S3 event notification: responds within seconds, scales to zero (no cost when idle), 20 s ≪ the 15-min limit. Triggers: "highly unpredictable", "none for days", "within seconds of arrival", "cost-effective, low-ops".
why_not: ASG on EC2 and ECS on EC2 running 24/7 cost money when idle and need maintenance; an EKS CronJob runs on a schedule, not per object, and is the heaviest to operate.
